title: A team login's phone and browser alerts follow the login
text: A company's chat alerts now reach a team login's phone or browser only while that login is switched on and can see chat. A login that is switched off, removed, or without the chat tick gets nothing, and removing a login also deletes its alert devices. The daily summary email also no longer treats a team login's alerts as if the owner had them. Nothing changes on screen, and no company was affected yet.
